title: Now Playing Music Player
desc: Dynamic track player with morphing radial gradient album artwork, real-time equalizer audio bars, scrubber progress, track info carousel, and playback controls.

title: Segmented Navigation Control
desc: Smooth 4-state segmented control (All, Design, Code, Ship) with gliding active pill selector and spring physics.

title: 6-Digit OTP Verification
desc: Two-factor verification card with rolling digits, active box glow, and circular SVG countdown timer.

title: Weekly Calendar Strip
desc: Interactive week strip with active day pill glider, dual-tone date numbers, and smooth transitions.

title: Interactive Task Checklist
desc: Dynamic checklist with animated SVG checkmarks, text strike-through lines, and rolling completed counter.

title: World Clock & Weather
desc: Minimalist time widget with rotating sun rays, rolling minute digits, weekday date, and rolling temperature.

title: Daily Streak Tracker
desc: Habit progress indicator with rolling day counter and 7-day progress bar cascade popping with spring elasticity.

title: File Upload Progress
desc: File transfer card with animated gradient progress bar, percentage roll, and file icon morphing into verified checkmark.

title: Day & Night Theme Switcher
desc: Interactive theme switcher with rotating sun/moon icons, smooth color inversion, and elastic sliding switch knob.

title: Live Collaborator Presence
desc: Live presence queue with pulsing green status beacon, rolling active user count, and overlapping avatar stack.

title: Live Route GPS Navigation
desc: Procedural GPS map with street grid, dashed route line tracing, bouncing arrival pin, moving vehicle dot, and rolling ETA.

title: Real-Time Chat Stream
desc: Live message stream with staggered speech bubbles, upward fluid stack scrolling, and bouncing typing indicator dots.

title: Kanban Sprint Board
desc: Interactive 3-column sprint board with card reordering, floating card drag with dynamic elevation shadow, and rolling sprint progress.

title: Command Palette (⌘K)
desc: Quick command menu with simulated keystroke typing, blinking cursor, sliding keyboard highlight, and action items.

title: Activity Progress Rings
desc: Triple concentric SVG activity rings with smooth spring-driven stroke dasharray transitions and rolling percentage indicator.

title: Dual Volume & Brightness Sliders
desc: Dual vertical pill sliders with dynamic fluid fill levels, embedded iconography, and spring bounce physics.

title: Focus Countdown Timer
desc: Pomodoro focus timer with radial SVG countdown ring and rolling MM:SS countdown digits.

title: Multi-Device Battery Monitor
desc: Battery level monitor for Phone, Watch, and Laptop with animated fill bars, pulsing charging lightning bolts, and percentage readouts.

title: Social Heart Like Button
desc: Micro-interaction featuring shockwave ripple ring, heart scale bounce spring, and rolling like count tally.

title: Financial Portfolio Sparkline
desc: Live investment card featuring real-time procedural noise chart curve, gradient area fill, glowing pulse cursor, and rolling balances.

title: Dynamic HSL Color Picker
desc: Interactive color selector with live hex preview swatch, rainbow spectrum slider, and selectable preset color swatches.

title: Stacked Notification Center
desc: Dynamic notification stack with smooth vertical cascade feed of incoming app alerts with spring physics.

title: Pricing Plan Tier Switch
desc: Monthly vs Yearly pricing switch with sliding pill glider, rolling price counter ($39 vs $49), and popping discount badge.

title: Morphing Deploy Button
desc: Interactive action button that transitions from idle state -> loading progress bar with percentage -> verified "Live" checkmark.
